title: WEHI-SODA-Hub/sp_segment pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.description: Sample name. Must be unique in the samplesheet and contain no spaces. Used as the prefix of every output file.
sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

run_backsub.description: Run background subtraction before segmentation. COMET OME-TIFF only.
run_backsub.errorMessage: Run backsub must be a boolean

run_mesmer.description: Segment with Mesmer. At most one of run_mesmer, run_cellpose and run_cellsam can be true per row.
run_mesmer.errorMessage: Run mesmer must be a boolean

run_cellpose.description: Segment with Cellpose (patched, through sopa). At most one of run_mesmer, run_cellpose and run_cellsam can be true per row.
run_cellpose.errorMessage: Run cellpose must be a boolean

run_cellsam.description: Segment with CellSAM. At most one of run_mesmer, run_cellpose and run_cellsam can be true per row.
run_cellsam.errorMessage: Run cellsam must be a boolean

tiff.description: Path to the input image: a COMET OME-TIFF or a multi-channel MIBI TIFF. The path cannot contain spaces.
tiff.errorMessage: TIFF file must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.tiff/.tif'

nuclear_channel.description: Name of the nuclear channel, e.g. DAPI. Required when a segmenter is selected.
nuclear_channel.errorMessage: Nuclear channel must be one channel name; it cannot contain the characters " ' : ,

membrane_channels.description: Names of the membrane channels, separated by ':', e.g. CD45:HLA I. Required when a segmenter is selected. Several channels are combined into one with combine_method.
membrane_channels.errorMessage: Membrane channels must be channel names separated by ':'; names cannot contain the characters " ' ,
